Commentary.Commentary: Right then! England need 158 to win and seal the series with a game to spare. They have the batting line-up to chase this down while the Aussies would hope that they can pick up a few quick wickets and try their level-best to square the series. Join us for the chase in a while.

Australia, on the other hand, would be happy as at one stage, it looked like they will not reach 130 but the assault in the three overs allowed them to post a total above 150 and that is a respectable total. All was not well for them at the start as they lost 3 wickets cheaply and needed a partnership between Finch and Stoinis to bail them out. They were 89 for 5 at the end of the 13th over and reaching 157 is a good comeback.

A good last over for Australia but it has been a terrific bowling performance from England. They were right on the money from the start. Archer started it all, picking up the wicket of Warner in the first over. Wood picked up the wicket of Carey. Their fielding was excellent as Morgan ran Steven Smith out. They were excellent till the death overs but they will be slightly disappointed, giving away 40 runs in the last three overs and giving Australia a respectable total on the board.
On a good length around off, Starc looks to play at that but it comes off his inside edge and goes towards the leg side and the batters will come back for the second. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 157 FOR 7.
Mitchell Starc comes out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Jofra hits bulls-eye as Agar has to walk back now after playing a short cameo for the visitors. This is dished out on a full length around off, Agar gets under the ball and plays it to the right of Jofra and looks for the quick single but Archer grabs the ball and he throws it at the wickets at the striker's end and doesn't miss and Agar has to walk back, he was miles outside his crease.
WIDE! Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Pat looks to flick it but misses and Buttler collects and the batters run through for a quick single.
SIX! Cummins, you beauty! What a crisp shot! Good length around off, Cummins plays this on the up over the long off fence for a maximum. Good batting by Cummins!

FOUR! Lucky runs but Australia won't mind this! On a full length around off, Cummins looks to heave this towards the leg side and the outside edge takes the ball over Rashid at short third man and it will race away for four runs.
WIDE! Archer can't believe how this could be a wide! A short delivery outside off, the umpire signals wide as this is above shoulder height.
Leg bye! Excellent bowling by Archer here! A yorker again outside off, Agar tries to dig it out but it comes off his pads towards the short third man and the batters get a single.
WIDE! Back of a good length ball around middle and leg, Agar looks to flick but misses and Buttler pouches this. Wide signalled.
Yorker on middle, Pat squeezes this one out and plays this one through to the cover region for a single.
Fullish outside off, Cummins drives it to the cover region for a single.
Low full toss outside off, Agar drives it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Firm hit by Ashton Agar! Full delivery outside off, Agar thrashes it through mid on and into the fence.
Full delivery on off, Cummins pushes it to mid off for a single.
Pat Cummins comes out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Jordan replaces Archer and he gets the breakthrough. The dangerous Maxwell has to walk back. This is an important wicket for England as Maxwell can be very dangerous in the last few overs. Jordan bowls a good length ball outside off, Maxwell clears his front leg and then looks to swing it away but gets and outside edge back towards Buttler. He makes no mistake.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot from Maxwell! Jordan dishes a full delivery outside off, Maxwell drives it out to deep cover for a boundary.
A low full toss again around off and middle, Glenn plays this towards the long on region for another single.
A low full toss around off, Agar works this one towards mid on for one more run.
A slower one outside off again, Maxwell pushes this to deep point for a single.
A slower one again outside off, Curran cuts this towards point for one run.
A slower one around middle, Maxwell hits this towards the cover region for a single.

SIX! Maxwell needs to hit some more of these out the park if they are to cross the 150-run mark here. A slower back of a length ball around off, Maxwell heaves this one over the mid-wicket region and Jofra attempts to stop this but it crosses the fence.
Excellent Yorker on middle, Agar manages to dig it out back to the bowler.
Nicely played! Full delivery on the pads, Agar flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Short ball around middle, Agar looks to pull but it takes the top edge and it goes to fine leg for a couple.
Full delivery outside off, Maxwell drives it to deep point for a single.
Full delivery on the pads, Agar flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Archer is on his knees to appeal for LBW! Slower ball on middle, Maxwell looks to pull but gets hit on the pads. Archer appeals but the umpire is not interested. Good decision not to review as it was missing the stumps. A run added to the total.
Jofra Archer is coming back on.
Yorker around off, Maxwell gets under this and works this towards the deep cover area for a single and he will retain the strike for the next over.
Back of a good length ball around off and middle, Maxwell pulls this towards the deep square leg area and will get two runs.
Good length delivery outside off, Agar looks to play this but it takes an outside edge and goes towards the fielder at third man for a single.
On a good length outside off, Agar cuts this fine towards the deep square leg area and Moeen Ali does well in the deep to stop this one as the batters come back for the second run.
Good length ball around off, Maxwell opens up the face of his bat and gently nudges this to the fielder at short third man. A single will be taken.
Good length ball around off and middle, Glenn tucks this away towards the deep mid-wicket region. The batters run hard and will come back for the second.
Chris Jordan is back into the attack. 2-0-20-1 are his figures so far.
Floated on off, Maxwell pushes it to cover and takes a single.
Shorter on middle, Ashton flicks it to deep square leg for a single. 100 up for Australia.
EDGY FOUR! Just wide of the first slip fielder! Flighted outside off, Agar looks to cut but it goes past the diving Malan at first slip and into the third man fence.
Flatter on middle, Glenn tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, Agar flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
An appeal for LBW turned down! Floated on the pads, Agar looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Moeen Ali is coming into the attack.
On a good length around off, Agar flicks this towards the square leg area for another single. The batters contemplate the second run, but decide against it eventually.
BEATEN! Good bowling by Wood! Good length ball outside off, Agar looks to play at this but he misses this one as Buttler pouches this one.
On a short of a good length, Maxwell flicks this one of his hips towards deep mid-wicket for one more run.
Good length delivery outside off, Agar punches this through the point region and the batters will exchange ends.
Good length ball around off, solid defense by Agar sends the ball back to Wood.
Short ball outside off, Maxwell looks to push this towards the off side but an inside edge sends the ball towards mid-wicket and the batters will get a single.
Ashton Agar comes out to bat. Mark Wood is back on. 3-0-21-1 are his figures so far.

OUT! CAUGHT! Once again, Rashid strikes off his final delivery of his spell! Marcus Stoinis had just started to look good but he has to perish! This is brilliant bowling from Rashid! He has been an integral player for England and he keeps on showing with his performances. Rashid bowls a leg spinner on off, Stoinis looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes to the right of Morgan at first slip. He dives to that side and takes a good catch. Australia 5 down now.
Tossed up outside off, Stoinis lifts it towards extra cover and picks up a couple before the fielder cleans it up.
Tossed up on the pads, Maxwell flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Googly on middle, Maxwell looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, Stoinis drives it to long off for a single.
SIX! Beautifully played! Stoinis is a big guy and he shows it with this shot! Flighted ball outside off, Stoinis powers it over long off for a biggie.
Glenn Maxwell is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! England have got the very dangerous Finchy out! He will be disappointed with this shot and the manner in which he got out as he was looking to get his groove on but he will have to walk the long walk back to the hut now. Back of a length ball outside off, Finch looks to cut this towards backward point but it comes off his inside edge and uproots the off stump to get England their fourth wicket of the afternoon. Smart bowling by Jordan!

FOUR! England has to regroup here as Finch is working his magic here slowly! Short of a good length around middle and leg, Finch pulls this one past Jofra at short fine leg and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Good length around off, Stoinis plays this on the up towards the mid on region and it just drops before the fielder at long on can grab this. The batters will exchange ends.
Leg bye! On a good length around off, Finch looks to work it towards the leg side but misses and it comes off his pad towards the off side. The batters take a single.

FOUR! A good pickup this by Finch! These two are stitching a good partnership after the visitors lost three wickets! Back of a good length around off and leg, Finch tucks this on the up towards the fine leg region and will get four runs.
Good length ball around off, Finch works this towards the fielder at cover.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Brilliant bowling from Rashid! Googly on off, spins in. Stoinis looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Rashid puts up a huge appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. No review taken.
Flighted ball outside off, Finch drives it to deep cover for a single.N
SIX! He did not middle that but it has still gone for a six! Loopy ball on off, Finch dances down the track and lifts it over the long on region for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle, Finch defends it back to the bowler.
Floated ball on middle, Stoinis pushes it uppishly towards deep cover for a single.
Flighted on middle, Finch sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
A slower one around off, Finch nudges this towards the mid on region and they run for the single. Stoinis takes off for the second but a loud no from Finch sends him back into his crease.
On a good length outside off, Stoinis plays this one towards point for a single.
A low full toss around off, Stoinis pushes this towards mid off.
A full delivery around off, Finch works this towards the mid-wicket region for one run.
Good length around leg, Finch tries to flick but it comes off his pads and Buttler collects this one.
Good news for all England fans! Morgan is back on the field after getting some treatment done on his fingers.
Good length ball around off, Stoinis pushes this towards mid-wicket and will add one run to the total.
Nearly dragged it on! Flighted down the leg side, Finch looks to sweep but it hits the elbow and almost rolls onto the stumps.
Tossed up on middle, Finch plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, Stoinis punches it to deep cover for a single.
Flighted on the pads, Finch sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.

The physio is coming out to have a look at Eoin Morgan who seemed to have hurt himself on his finger. Not a good sign. Let's hope that he is fine. Ohh no, Morgan is going off. This is not good news for England.

Morgan has hurt himself there! Rashid bowls a full toss outside off, Stoinis drives it uppishly towards extra cover. Morgan looks to stop it but fails to do so and the batters pick up a single as the ball rolls to long off. Morgan has immediately called for the physio.
Low full toss on off, Finch works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A shorter one outside off, Stoinis plays this on the up just past Archer at mid off and the ball bounces before Jofra grasps this one, the batters will come back for the second.
Good length around the off pole, Stoinis pulls this one towards the mid-wicket area and will get two runs.
Fielding by Morgan here again is fantastic! On a good length outside off, Stoinis cuts this one towards the cover region and Morgan dives to his left to stop this one.
Good length around off, Stoinis fends this back towards Jordan.

SIX! Bang! What a powerful hit by the tall man here! Short of a good length ball around off, Stoinis pulls this one hard over the ropes at deep mid-wicket and will get six runs for his effort. Some more of these and Australia might be coming back into the game then.
On a good length around off, Finch nudges this towards point and the batters will take a quick single.
Chris Jordan comes into the attack.
Floated on off, it sticks on the surface. Stoinis looks to push but it goes uppishly as he is early into the shot. The ball lands in front of the fielder. Good start from Adil Rashid.
Flatter on off, Stoinis defends it back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Finch pushes it towards mid off for a single.

NOT OUT! That has gone off the middle of the bat! What made England take the review! A complete waste of a review. Rashid tosses this on middle, Finch lunges forward and defends it to cover. Rashid and Buttler think that it was pad first and appeal. The umpire is not interested and Rashid convinces Morgan to take the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that it has gone off the middle of the bat. England lose a review. The on-field umpire has a laugh about it after the decision and why not?
England have taken a review for LBW! It looks like it has gone off the bat. The replays roll in and they show that it has gone off the middle of the bat. Review wasted.
Quicker one on middle, Finch defends it to mid off.
Rashid starts with a floated ball outside off, Stoinis drives it to long off for a single.
Adil Rashid is coming into the attack.
Back of a length delivery around middle and leg, Stoinis pulls this into the ground towards the square leg area for a single. Australia are struggling at 39/3 at the end of the Powerplay.
A fullish delivery around off, Stoinis digs this one out towards the fielder at point.

FOUR! Poor fielding here at mid on by Tom Curran! This one had to be stopped but it will instead be four runs. On a good length around off and middle, Stoinis works this one fine down the ground past the diving fielder at mid on for four more runs. Much needed all these boundaries for the visitors!

FOUR! SO CLOSE FOR ANOTHER WICKET! On a good length around middle and leg, Stoinis flicks this off his pads and it just flies by Buttler who stretches hard to his left but can't pouch this as this races away to the fine leg fence.
Short of a good length delivery around the off pole, Stoinis pushes this away towards the fielder at point.
Back of a good length outside off to start off, Stoinis fends this out towards the off side.
Marcus Stoinis is the next man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! What is Steven Smith thinking? There is no run there and Australia are in tatters at the moment. Brilliant piece of work from Eoin Morgan! You cannot keep him out of the game. Good length ball on middle, Smith defends it towards mid on and takes off for a single. Morgan runs in from mid-wicket and has one stump to aim at and he hits. Smith knows that he is a goner and starts walking off. The on-field umpire wants to be sure and takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and they show that Smith was well out of his crease, so Smith has to continue walking. Australia struggling at 30 for 3.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs. Smith is walking. The replays show that he is miles out.
Fullish ball on middle, Smith looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
SIX! What a shot that is! Brilliant from Smith! Short ball on middle, Smith pulls it over the deep square fielder for a biggie. First one for him in this game.
BEATEN! There is something on the pitch! The ball is nipping around. Smith is surprised! Good length ball outside off, tails away. Smith looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Good length ball on middle, Smith defends it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Smith times that really well! Short ball on middle, Smith pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder comes across, slides and gets a hand on it but the ball goes into the fence.
Tom Curran is into the attack.
Good length ball outside the off stump, Finch works this through the covers on his back foot for a couple.

FOUR! Another one! Lucky this time for the visitors but they will accept this one gracefully! On a good length outside off, Finch looks to work this through the off side but it comes off his inside edge and races away to the ropes at the fine leg area.
Good length delivery outside the off pole, Finch pushes this to the fielder at point.

FOUR! Finally a boundary for this visitors! Much needed for Australia! A slower one outside off, Finch looks to play at it and it comes off the lower part of his bat and races away to the fence at third man.
Back of a good length ball around off, Finch plucks this out to cover region.
Short of a good length ball outside off, Finch punches this towards the off side.

Quick single! Back of a length on middle, Aaron tucks it to the leg side and calls Smith for a single. The fielder runs ahead and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Smith would have been in though.
On a length on middle, Finch looks to flick but it hits the gloves and rolls to the off side.
Full delivery on off, Finch defends it to the point region.
BEATEN! Excellent comeback delivery from Jofra Archer! Good length ball outside off, tailing away. Finch looks to defend but misses it completely.

SIX! There is a fielder in the deep but it goes way over! Archer bowls a short one which does rise high enough. Finch rocks on his back foot and helps it on its way over the deep square leg region for a maximum.

BEATEN! England have their tails up at the moment! This is terrific bowling from Archer! Good length ball outside off, Finch looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge and into the mitts of the keeper.
Good length outside off, Smith works this one towards the fielder at point. Australia are at 3/2 at the end of two overs!
Steven Smith is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a start by England here! Two wickets in just the first 2 overs and Australia are reeling here! Both the opening bowlers get a wicket each and England are looking good! The promotion of Carey up the order does not work out for the visitors here as Carey is sent back on a cheap score! On a good length around off, Carey moves to his left and looks to lift this one over the mid off region but it kisses his outside edge and Buttler catches this one with ease.
A good length ball around middle and leg, Finch tucks this towards the short fine leg area and Moeen does well to stop this one and save the hosts three runs as the batsmen get a single.
A short delivery around leg, Carey pulls this hard towards fine leg and it bounces just before Archer there and the batters get a single.
Good length around middle and leg, Carey looks to flick but misses and hits him on the pads and the ball rolls over to the off side. The bowler appeals but the umpire doesn't even move.
Back of a good length ball around middle and off, Carey fends this back to Wood.
Mark Wood will bowl from the other end.

Almost a run out! What is Australia doing? Archer digs a back of a length ball on off, Carey defends it to point. They want the single but hesitate for a second. The fielder comes ahead and throws it at the stumps at the keeper's end but misses. Would have been close. What a start from Archer! Just 1 from the over and a wicket.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery! Good length ball outside off, Carey looks to drive but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Carey leaves it alone.
Alex Carey makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! There is a clear spike as the ball passed the gloves and Warner has to go for a duck. He takes the review with him. Perfect start for England! Just the start that they needed! A wicket in the first over and they will be pleased with the start! Archer bowls a good length ball around off. It angles in and Warner looks to defend but it seems to have taken the edge back to the keeper. Buttler collects and England go up in an appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Warner is surprised and he takes the review immediately. He suggests that it has gone off the elbow. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is a spike as the ball passed the gloves. Warner makes his walk back to the pavilion.
David Warner has been given out caught behind! Warner has taken the review immediately and indicates that it has hit the elbow. Let's see what happens.
BEAUTIFUL BOWLING FROM ARCHER! Short ball around off, at 91 mph! Warner looks to defend but is hurried onto it and gets beaten.
Archer starts with a good length ball outside the off stump line, Warner covers his off stump and leaves it alone.
All set for the game to begin! The England players make their way out to the middle, followed by Aaron Finch and David Warner. Jofra Archer will start with the ball for the hosts.

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper, says that they would have bowled first. States that they are unchanged. Adds that they are delighted with the performance in the first T20I but still need to improve. Says that they would look to establish more partnerships and need to bowl better in the first 10 overs. States that Malan has been outstanding and his numbers are terrific and is hoping that he can continue.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that they will bat first and says that it looks like a decent wicket. States that they are unchanged. Says that they might look to change the batting order. Goes onto say that had a brief discussion about the collapse in the first T20I. Adds that they are confident about bouncing back.
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jos Buttler (WK), Jonny Bairstow, Dawid Malan, Tom Banton, Eoin Morgan (C), Moeen Ali, Chris Jordan, Tom Curran, Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood.
Australia (Unchanged Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Glenn Maxwell, Alex Carey (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Australia. They have elected to bat first.

Hello everyone! England are 1-0 up in the 3-match T20I series after they pulled a rabbit out of the hat in the first T20I. They will be going into this game with confidence and will hope to seal the series with a game to spare.  Australia, on the other hand, would be pulling their hair after they snatched defeat from the jaws of victory. Their middle order is a concern and they will want to level the series and get over the line and not botch things up. It promises to be another cracker of a game. Toss and team updates in a while.
